Its wire-ID lookup uses 174 eight-byte rows at VA 0x2a2f4c, comparing the wire word at row+4 and reading the native event at row+0. AppProxy 0x02033203 -> event0x54, 0x02033204 -> event0x55, and 0x02033212 -> event0xb3. Their predecessor-proven request-channel index is 53, (3,2), not controller index19 (1,2). No controller forwarding edge is asserted. This identifies the native consumer/decoder, not the lower-level queue-open registration implementation.

After wire-to-event lookup, nonzero packet length at packet+8 selects payload pointer packet+0xc; zero length selects null. The receive loop invokes registered callbacks with the mapped event and payload pointer. These instructions do not enforce a 16-byte load payload or validate native map flags. Subscriber binding and scheduling from event0x55 into the selected load task remain unclosed.
